name: 3121-twocount-ruling-02-one-count-in-a-case-holding-the-group-load
models:
module core
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key uid string -
key time_ms int ms
module probe
version 0.1.0
distribution public
source "probe"
key x int -
key y int -
key z int -
key val int -
key qty int -
list nums "a list"
list recs "a list"
list items "a list"
list subs "a list"
pack:
format probe
version 0.31.0
distribution public
source "probe"
uses probe
wire bits
layout sequential
field probe.x 8 uint
count a 8
switch probe.x
  case 1
    count b 8
    group probe.nums count @a @b
      field probe.val 8 uint
    end
  case 2
    group probe.recs count @a
      field probe.x 8 uint
    end
end
